result.topic_en: Ramanujan derives transformation formulas for Lambert-type series in two variables with αβ = π² (Eisenstein-series identities) by comparing coefficients in an earlier identity (21), with the example σ_5 sum at α = β = π.
result.transcription:
Add Ms a 94 18(62) (62)
(24) $\alpha\left\{\sigma_1(1)e^{-2\alpha}+\sigma_1(2)e^{-4\alpha}+\sigma_1(3)e^{-6\alpha}+\cdots\right\}$
$+\beta\left\{\sigma_1(1)e^{-2\beta}+\sigma_1(2)e^{-4\beta}+\sigma_1(3)e^{-6\beta}+\cdots\right\}$
$=\frac{\alpha+\beta}{24}-\frac{1}{4}$
The coefficient of $1/x^r$ in the expansion of the [-left-]{+right+}[?]-hand-side of (21) must be 0, $r$ being any positive integer $\geq 2$, as there is no coefficient for $1/x^r$ in the right-hand side. That is, if $\alpha\beta=\pi^2$ and $r$ any positive integer $\geq 2$, then
(25) $\alpha^r\left\{\frac{B_{2r}}{4r}\cos\pi r+\frac{1^{2r-1}}{e^{2\alpha}-1}+\frac{2^{2r-1}}{e^{4\alpha}-1}+\frac{3^{2r-1}}{e^{6\alpha}-1}+\cdots\right\}$
$=(-\beta)^r\left\{\frac{B_{2r}}{4r}\cos\pi r+\frac{1^{2r-1}}{e^{2\beta}-1}+\frac{2^{2r-1}}{e^{4\beta}-1}+\frac{3^{2r-1}}{e^{6\beta}-1}+\cdots\right\}$
where $B_2=1/6,\ B_4=1/30,\ B_6=1/42,\ \ldots$ the Bernoullian numbers.
(26) or $\alpha^r\left\{\frac{B_{2r}}{4r}\cos\pi r+\sigma_{2r-1}(1)e^{-2\alpha}+\sigma_{2r-1}(2)e^{-4\alpha}+\sigma_{2r-1}(3)e^{-6\alpha}+\cdots\right\}$
$=(-\beta)^r\left\{\frac{B_{2r}}{4r}\cos\pi r+\sigma_{2r-1}(1)e^{-2\beta}+\sigma_{2r-1}(2)e^{-4\beta}+\sigma_{2r-1}(3)e^{-6\beta}+\cdots\right\}$
As an example when $r=3$ and $\alpha=\beta=\pi$, we have
(27) $\sigma_5(1)e^{-2\pi}+\sigma_5(2)e^{-4\pi}+\sigma_5(3)e^{-6\pi}+\cdots=\frac{1}{504}$
Now equating the coefficients of $x^r$ in both sides in (21) we can show that, if $\alpha\beta=\pi^2$ and $r$ any positive integer $\geq 2$, then
(28) $(4\alpha)^{1-r}\left\{\frac{1}{2}\zeta(2r-1)+\frac{1^{1-2r}}{e^{2\alpha}-1}+\frac{2^{1-2r}}{e^{4\alpha}-1}+\frac{3^{1-2r}}{e^{6\alpha}-1}+\cdots\right\}$
$-(-4\beta)^{1-r}\left\{\frac{1}{2}\zeta(2r-1)+\frac{1^{1-2r}}{e^{2\beta}-1}+\frac{2^{1-2r}}{e^{4\beta}-1}+\frac{3^{1-2r}}{e^{6\beta}-1}+\cdots\right\}$
